slides.hook: ACME's Q2 2023 revenue growth sits in a chunk that never names ACME or Q2. Put a short line of context on each chunk before you index it.

slides.title: One LLM call / per [chunk]
slides.text: Contextual retrieval changes ingest only. Query-side search stays the same:

steps: Split each document into chunks as usual.
For each chunk, send a small LLM the whole document and the chunk.
Get back a short context, usually 50 to 100 tokens.
Embed that text and add the same text to the BM25 index.

slides.title: The answer ties / for [5th]
slides.text: Test: 16 made-up quarterly reports (4 companies, Q1 to Q4 2023), split at `chunk_size=150` characters into 96 chunks. BM25 via `rank_bm25`.

visuals.caption: "What was the revenue growth for ACME Corp in Q2 2023?"

options.note: They name ACME, and say nothing about revenue

slides.after: All 16 Results chunks share the same four words with the query: "the", "revenue", "was" and "in".

slides.title: Title and heading / come [free]
slides.text: Before paying for an LLM call, prepend what the document already knows:

visuals.code:
{{ACME Corp · Q2 2023 quarterly report ·}}
{{Results}}
## Results
The company's revenue grew by 3% over
the previous quarter.

## Margin
Gross margin was 40%, and operating costs
were in line with plan.

slides.title: The context / [prompt]
slides.text: A title says who and when. The LLM adds what the chunk is about and facts it leans on from elsewhere in the document. Anthropic's prompt:

slides.title: Cache the / [document]
slides.text: Every chunk of a document sends the same document. Mark it for prompt caching: if it's long enough to cache and the calls come close together, later calls read it from the cache:

visuals.code:
import anthropic
client = anthropic.Anthropic()

def context_for(doc, chunk, model):
    r = client.messages.create(
        model=model, max_tokens=150,
        messages=[{"role": "user",
                   "content": [
            {"type": "text",
             "text": DOC.format(doc=doc),
             {{"cache_control":}}
                 {"type": "ephemeral"}},
            {"type": "text",
             "text": CHUNK.format(
                 chunk=chunk)}]}])
    return r.content[0].text

text = context_for(d, c, m) + "\n" + c

slides.title: Failed retrievals / [down] 49%
slides.text: Anthropic's test: the share of relevant chunks missing from the top 20 (1 minus recall@20), averaged across their datasets, with Gemini Text 004 embeddings.
bullets: Emb: contextual embeddings. +BM25: contextual BM25 added.
+RR: reranked by Cohere, 150 candidates cut to 20.
35% and 49% fewer failures; 67% with the reranker.

slides.title: You pay once, / at [ingest]
slides.text: The context is written when you index. A query makes no extra LLM call; each retrieved chunk is 50 to 100 tokens longer:

options.note: Cache the document; each chunk is sent once
Each context is written from the whole doc

slides.after: Anthropic's estimate with prompt caching: $1.02 per million document tokens, for 800-token chunks and 8k-token documents.

slides.title: Context can pull / the [wrong] chunk
slides.text: Same test, with a template context line on all 96 chunks (no LLM call):

options.output: "...Q2 2023 quarterly report and gives the quarter's revenue growth over Q1 2023."
"...Q3 2023 quarterly report and gives the quarter's revenue growth over !!Q2 2023!!."

slides.after: The Q3 line is correct, but naming Q2 2023 gives it the query's terms. Test real queries on a sample first.

cards.title: Use it when
items: Chunks point elsewhere: "the company", "this clause", "the previous quarter"
Many documents share one layout: quarterly reports, contracts, manuals
One LLM call per chunk at ingest fits your budget

cards.title: Move on when
items: The knowledge base is under 200,000 tokens: Anthropic suggests putting it all in the prompt
Each chunk stands alone: FAQ entries, product records
Title + heading already ranks the answers first in your eval

slides.title: [Cheat] sheet
rows: Prepend 50 to 100 tokens of context to each chunk
Embed that text and put the same text in BM25
Try title + section heading first: no LLM call
One LLM call per chunk at ingest; cache the document
Re-run a document's contexts when it changes
Context that names other periods can tie: test queries first

slides.line: A context line tells each chunk where it came from. Chunk size decides what one vector holds, and a retrieval eval is how you set size and overlap.
